title: Spatiotemporal Distillation via Recurrent Bottlenecks for Aortic Tracking
abstract: arXiv:2608.23879v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cardiac cine-MRI serves as a direct visual indicator of cardiovascular hemodynamics by capturing the continuous wall motion of the aorta. Quantifying these dynamic structural changes across the cardiac cycle is essential for measuring aortic distensibility, a primary marker of arterial stiffness. However, standard 2D segmentation networks focus on each frame independently. Consequently, when rapid systolic flow temporarily obscures the aorta's boundaries, this lack of continuous context results in frame-to-frame tracking dropouts and boundary inconsistencies. Spatiotemporal ($2\text{D}+t$) networks can enforce temporal consistency across the sequence but suffer from a scarcity of expert annotations. To address this, we present a semi-supervised spatiotemporal ($2\text{D}$ to $2\text{D}+t$) knowledge distillation framework exploiting the cardiac cycle. The framework distills a spatial teacher's expertise into a spatiotemporal student ne

translated_title: 基于循环瓶颈的时空蒸馏用于主动脉跟踪
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23879v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：心脏电影MRI通过捕捉主动脉的连续壁运动，作为心血管血流动力学的直接视觉指标。量化这些跨心动周期的动态结构变化对于测量主动脉扩张性（动脉僵硬度的主要标志）至关重要。然而，标准的2D分割网络独立处理每一帧。因此，当快速收缩期血流暂时遮挡主动脉边界时，缺乏连续上下文会导致帧间跟踪丢失和边界不一致。时空（2D+t）网络可以强制序列间的时间一致性，但面临专家标注稀缺的问题。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种利用心动周期的半监督时空（2D到2D+t）知识蒸馏框架。该框架将空间教师的专业知识蒸馏到时空学生网络中。
tldr: 本文提出一种半监督时空知识蒸馏框架，通过循环瓶颈将2D空间教师的知识转移到2D+t时空学生，以解决主动脉跟踪中因缺乏时间一致性导致的帧间丢失和边界不一致问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a semi-supervised spatiotemporal knowledge distillation framework with recurrent bottlenecks, transferring 2D spatial teacher knowledge to a 2D+t student to address frame-to-frame tracking dropouts and boundary inconsistencies in aortic tracking.
